blocks.title: Project Summary
paragraphs: RWW Group partnered with Zuse Digital to develop a streamlined ordering platform that could simplify the quote request process for their extensive uniform catalogue. The goal was to allow existing customers to configure garments and submit quote requests in just three steps—despite the complexity of thousands of SKUs, colour options, and branding variables. The solution required more than just a sleek interface—it demanded scalable architecture, precise image rendering capabilities, and an intuitive user flow.

blocks.title: Strategy & Execution
paragraphs: We kicked off the project with a Discovery Workshop, aligning stakeholders and mapping the user journey in detail. Our team then designed a modular UI system and built a responsive web application using React, TailwindCSS, and Next.js. Key features included real-time garment previews, colour and logo customisation, and a seamless quoting workflow. The backend was powered by a headless CMS, supported by robust API integrations and a relational database structured for high performance and future growth.

Throughout the process, we used agile sprints, Figma-based prototypes, and iterative testing across all breakpoints. We ensured fast load speeds through a global CDN, prioritised Core Web Vitals, and maintained security through HTTPS and API rate limiting. Extensive QA and feedback loops ensured a polished, scalable final product.

bullets.body: Fully responsive UI/UX design with a 3-step quoting experience
Custom frontend and backend development with modular architecture
Advanced image rendering for garment colour changes and branding previews
Relational database for scalable product catalogue management
API integration with headless CMS and dynamic quote system
CDN setup for fast global asset delivery
Cloud-based infrastructure with CI/CD, monitoring, and backups
Cross-device and breakpoint testing for performance and usability

about: Zuse Digital delivered the end-to-end concept, design, development & deployment of the C-19 Tracker App for the Victorian State Government. blocks.title: Challenges & Strategic Approach
paragraphs: The fast-moving COVID-19 crisis created:

bullets.body: Public confusion & anxiety as guidelines evolved daily.
Overloaded contact-tracing teams struggling with manual workflows.
Data-privacy concerns around tracking individual movements.
Discovery & Strategy Workshops with health officials to define requirements and user journeys.
End-to-End Delivery from wireframes and UI design through full-stack development and QA.
Data-Driven UX featuring an intuitive map interface with real-time exposure overlays.

blocks.title: Solution & Deliverables
paragraphs: Zuse Digital led every phase to build a robust, scalable app:

bullets.title: Interactive Risk Map

bullets.body: Opt-in location logs reconstruct movements and flag potential exposures while preserving privacy.

bullets.title: Alert Notification System
bullets.body: Instant push alerts with precise time-and-place details. In-app archive of all personal exposure notifications

bullets.title: Integrated Location Services
bullets.body: via third-party APIs for nearby hospitals, pharmacies, supermarkets, and support centres.

bullets.title: Information Hub
bullets.body: Live dashboards showcasing statewide COVID-19 statistics, official advisories, and prevention guidance.
45% reduction in reported user anxiety through transparent, on-demand exposure insights.
30% faster government identification of high-risk zones and resource deployment.

25% decrease in field-team dispatches, optimising public-health budgets and manpower.
